summary: Full backend + frontend testing for de-affiliation & on-site checkout revamp of Paws & Whiskers India. All 10 pytest backend tests pass (products list=10, no affiliate_url, variants present, product-checkout Stripe session creation with validation for invalid variant/unknown product/qty out of range, payment status kind=order, support flow still works). Frontend: home cards render with view-product-button-{id}, product-image-link-{id}; product page /products/farmina-nd-prime-cat has all required data-testids (product-page, product-name, product-rating, product-buy-box, variant-1.5-kg, variant-5-kg, qty-increase/decrease/value, product-total-price, buy-now-button, related-products); 5 kg × 2 total correctly = ₹ 13,800; /products/does-not-exist shows product-not-found; article /guides/best-cat-food-india-2026 has quick-answer-view-product, table-view-product-*, review-view-product-* internal links and NO affiliate-disclosure-banner; no 'amazon','flipkart','affiliate','commission' text present on Home or Article; buy-now-button redirects to checkout.stripe.com; completed a full Stripe TEST payment (4242…) and landed on /payment/success with data-testid order-success-message showing product name/variant/qty.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py getting large (~700 lines with seed data); consider moving PRODUCTS/GUIDES/CATEGORIES seed to a data module for readability.
GET /api/guides/{slug} returns 200 with {'error':'not found'} for missing slug instead of 404 (inconsistent with /api/products/{id}); not in scope for this task but worth aligning.
product_checkout uses tax_code txcd_99999999 (general) — fine, but hardcoded; consider category-level tax codes long term.
Stripe managed-payments fallback path is good; consider narrowing except clause and logging.
